v1.0.2d (7 March 2022) |feed_title = Valentine's Update |previous_update = [[v1.0.1]] |next_update = [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.0.2''' is the thirty-second update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 13th of February 2022. This update is notable for bringing the [[Season of Love]], the fourth season in Tower Defense Simulator. This update was also given the name '''Valentines 2022 Update''', as it added the [[Season of Love]]. This version encompassed five updates, the main v1.0.2 update (released 13 February 2022) and three minor updates, the v1.0.2a (released the same day as v1.0.2, 13 February 2022), v1.0.2b (released 23 February 2022), v1.0.2c (released 7 March 2022) and v1.0.2d (released the same day as v1.0.2c, 7 March 2022). ==Additions== *{{LoveLetter|Love Letters}} *[[Season of Love]] **Rewards: ***Rank 1 -
